subject: NovaHealth POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@novahealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your POC started next week: 

1) Success criteria (what NovaHealth needs to validate):
- Throughput: 30 concurrent requests with median latency < 300ms for typical prompts
- Cost: below $0.015 per 1K tokens for inference in our test profile
- Quality: >= 85% on the provided evaluation prompt set (see eval plan)
- Security: SSO access, IP allowlist, and audit logs available for the test window

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Access provisioning (SSO invites, API keys, IP allowlist)
- Week 1: Smoke tests + integration validation (sample queries, SDK integration)
- Week 2: Load/latency tests and batch evaluation against your prompt set
- Week 3: Results review and decision meeting (stakeholders: Alex, Samantha, CS/Eng)

3) Owners / asks: 
- NovaHealth: send SSO domain + list of IP ranges to allow; confirm point person for API questions (we have API Team included)
- Redwood: we'll provision scoped API keys, SSO invites, and a temporary project with logs enabled; Priyom will set up keys and Nikhil will coordinate load tests

4) Access details we need from you to provision: 
- SSO provider (Okta/GSuite/Azure AD) and admin email to invite
- IP ranges for allowlist (CIDR) or confirmation to use VPN bastion
- Any egress region preference (us-east, us-west, eu-central)

I've attached a short POC intake form and our ops checklist to speed provisioning. If you can return the completed intake form and the IP/SSO details by EOD Tuesday (6/22), we can target a Wed (6/23) provisioning and a Mon (6/28) start for smoke tests.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

-- 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: NovaHealth POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick answers: 

- SSO: Okta. Admin to invite is samantha.lee@novahealth.com (please send Okta invite to that email)
- IP allowlist: initial ranges are 35.192.0.0/14, 34.224.0.0/12 (our infra/security will lock these down further if needed)
- Region preference: us-east (closest to our prod region)
- API point person: api-team@novahealth.com (they'll reach out for integration questions)

We're aligned on the success criteria. One ask: can the API keys be scoped to only the POC project and restricted to 100k tokens/day? Also would prefer keys rotated after the test window.

I'll fill out the intake form and send it back by EOD Tuesday. Targeting the same provisioning timeline works for us.
